recognize_zh: 高倍下一群細胞中混有核呈腎形或折疊、胞質灰藍含空泡的單核球與前單核球，以及骨髓細胞、分葉嗜中性球與小淋巴球，顯示單核球系與顆粒球系共同增生，符合 CMML 的骨髓表現。
features: Cluster of mixed monocytic and granulocytic cells
Monocytes and promonocytes with reniform to folded nuclei and fine chromatin
Gray-blue cytoplasm with fine granules and occasional vacuoles
Admixed myelocytes, band and segmented neutrophils
Small lymphocytes and an erythroid precursor present; blasts not predominant
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at high power shows a cluster of mixed cells comprising monocytes and promonocytes with reniform to folded nuclei, fine chromatin, and gray-blue vacuolated cytoplasm, together with myelocytes, band and segmented neutrophils, and occasional small lymphocytes. Blasts do not predominate, and overt granulocytic dysplasia is not evident in this field. Findings are consistent with a myelomonocytic proliferation compatible with chronic myelomonocytic leukemia when correlated with peripheral blood monocytosis.

ddx.vs: Requires ≥20% myeloblasts, monoblasts, and promonocytes, which are not predominant here.
Morphology may overlap; lack of dysplasia and absence of clonal markers favor a reactive process.
aCML has prominent dysgranulopoiesis with monocytes <10% of peripheral WBC.
